p04_card.author_interpretation: The authors interpret these results as showing that the tested C-terminal phosphomimetic substitutions do not impair TDP-43 nuclear import. They explicitly state that effects on intracellular transport in other cell types cannot be excluded.
p04_card.biological_context: Hormone-inducible live-cell nuclear-import reporter assay within the subsection's cellular experiments. TDP-43 variants were fused to tandem EGFP and two glucocorticoid-receptor hormone-binding domains. The caption reports a 50-minute time course, three independent replicates and at least 42 cells per condition.
p04_card.endpoint: Reporter nuclear-import kinetics, quantified through cytoplasmic fluorescence.
p04_card.intervention_comparator: Dexamethasone-triggered import of reporters containing Wt, 12D or 12A TDP-43.
negative_findings: No difference in import rate was reported among Wt, 12D and 12A under the tested hormone-inducible reporter conditions.
negative_quotes: We examined reporters containing the different TDP‐43 variants (Wt, 12D, 12A) and found that their import rates were indistinguishable
not_established: General nuclear-pore permeability, transport of other cargos and nucleoporin phosphorylation are not reported in the current view.
Statistical equivalence bounds and transport outcomes under ALS-associated conditions are not reported in the current view.
p04_card.reported_observation: Authors report that nuclear-import rates of the three TDP-43 reporter variants were indistinguishable.
